operator_interactions.question: The task and glossary leave pause semantics unresolved. Existing scheduling uses enabled; manual runs ignore enabled, retries and alerts proceed for active Runs. Please decide: (1) should pause block only new scheduled Runs, or also manual Runs? (2) should in-progress Runs/retries/alerts continue unchanged? (3) should resume preserve a Job's prior enabled/disabled state? My recommendation is an independent paused flag: block new scheduled Runs only, allow manual Runs, preserve in-progress Run/retry/alert behavior, and leave enabled unchanged on pause/resume. If dashboard presentation has a specific requirement, please supply it; otherwise I will expose a separate Paused column while preserving Enabled and Last result.
operator_interactions.answer: (1) A scheduled start while paused is skipped and is not queued. Manual Runs remain allowed while paused. (2) An in-progress Run continues to terminal outcome; preserve retries/alerts. (3) No additional guidance on enabled representation/dashboard presentation; TASK preservation, public interfaces and reversible judgment. No other product requirements supplied.
